readout_other: Evans blue extravasation; H&E and VAF-TOLB staining; Modified Glasgow Coma Scale; skull thermocouple heating
direction_notes: Safety study only; no neuromodulatory effect was assessed.
safety_notes: No tissue damage, BBB opening, haemorrhage or MRI abnormality; no pain signs in sheep #R1; ex vivo skull heating peaked at 2.3 C; transcranial MI estimated 1.95 at maximum, slightly above the ITRUSST 1.9 threshold.

exposures.label: Scanning ultrasound (SUS) of the sheep brain

timing.protocol_description: Each spot sonicated for 6 s (10 ms pulses at 10 Hz) in a stepwise scanning mode over up to 50 spots on a 6 x 6 mm grid; some spots sonicated three times (12 and 18 s); sheep #R1 had five sessions 2-4 weeks apart.

source_quotes.n_subjects: This study was approved by the Animal Ethics Committee of the Queensland University of Technology (Approval #2024-3630- 20828) and rati<sup>fi</sup>ed by The University of Queensland, involving four 1.5- to 3-y-old female Merino sheep (average age: 2.45 y, average weight: 54.9 kg).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: A 64 mm diameter concave transducer (H-117, Sonic Concepts Inc., USA) was driven at 286 kHz by an arbitrary waveform generator (AFG31022, Tektronix Inc., USA) via a radio-frequency ampli<sup>fi</sup>er (240L, Electronics and Innovation, LTD., USA) and an impedance matching network supplied with the transducer.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: The PNP in free <sup>fi</sup>eld was then increased from 0.7 to 2.6 MPa to achieve an acoustic radiation force in sheep comparable to the one that in mice had achieved restorative bioeffects [3].
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: Factoring in 64 ± 5.8% skull attenuation measured from 13 spots of three sheep skulls (#N1−2 and a pilot experiment [data not shown]), a derated PNP of 0.9 ± 0.05 MPa with a maximum of 1.04 MPa was expected to be delivered into sheep brains.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: The 10 ms pulse length, 10 Hz pulse repetition frequency and 6-s sonication duration parameters were maintained.

source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: (a) Three sheep in the non-recovery group (#N1−3) received scanning ultrasound (SUS) treatments in one session and were euthanized after Evans blue injection.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.isppa_w_cm2: The maximal spatial-peak pulse-average intensity $( I _ { \mathrm { s p p a } } )$ and mechanical index (MI) were calculated as 37.5 W/cm<sup>2</sup> and 1.95, respectively.

flags.reason: Three sheep had one session; sheep #R1 had five sessions over 12 weeks, so no single value applies.
Maximal Isppa of 37.5 W/cm2 is stated as calculated, without saying free field or in situ.
Derated PNP 0.9 +/- 0.05 MPa (maximum 1.04 MPa) from 64 +/- 5.8% skull attenuation; recorded as the mean.
Up to 50 spots scanned across the sheep brain; no named anatomical target.
